# Stage 2 · Session 4 recovery checkpoint

Session 3 intact. Every final hand-maintained Stage 2 file is available in full below.

`uv.lock` is generated by `uv sync`; do not copy it by hand.

## Expected commands and output

```bash
uv sync
uv run ruff format .
uv run ruff check .
uv run pytest
git diff --check
uv run fairy-desktop
```

Representative automated result:

```text
All checks passed!
============================== 47 passed in ... ==============================
```

Expected visible result:

- The menu bar offers Show Fairy, Hide Fairy, Open Chat, and Quit NeuroFairy.
- One desktop launch creates one owned, authenticated backend child.
- The child uses an OS-assigned loopback port instead of competing for port 8000.
- The per-launch credential travels through the child process's standard input, never its
  command-line arguments.
- A forged or missing startup proof never enables chat.
- Missing or incorrect API credentials receive HTTP 401 and no chat body reaches the AI
  service.
- Child failure aborts any in-flight authenticated request before disabling later sends.
- A late health callback after Quit cannot restore the client URL or credential.
- Quit stops only the child process owned by this desktop launch.
- Manual `uvicorn fairy.web_app:app --reload` remains a separate browser-development path
  and is not reused by the desktop application.
